settings.ip-pool.copyCompliance: Anonymous quota is upstream-rate-limited; multiple exits do not bypass quota, they schedule across it. Pinned/subscription nodes first; public free proxies carry security and compliance risk.
settings.ip-pool.description: Schedules free-model availability across exit IPs: rotation, 429 cooldown, per-exit×model probes.
settings.ip-pool.enabledHint: Off = every request goes direct, exactly as if the pool were not installed.
settings.ip-pool.freeBlockedCountriesHint: ISO country codes, comma-separated; matching exits are refused. Default CN.
settings.ip-pool.freeEnabledHint: Fetch public free-proxy lists and admit survivors; off uses only the sources below.
settings.ip-pool.freeTargetSizeHint: Usable free exits the pool refills to (1-100, default 20).
settings.ip-pool.invalidCountry: Country codes are two letters (e.g. CN), comma-separated.
settings.ip-pool.invalidModel: Model id must not be empty.
settings.ip-pool.invalidRange: A value is out of range.
settings.ip-pool.manualHint: One per line: http://host:port or socks5://host:port. For your own nodes.
settings.ip-pool.pinnedAddressHint: e.g. a Clash mixed port http://127.0.0.1:7897, or a leased line. Pins on save.
settings.ip-pool.pinnedStrictHint: Failures pass through verbatim: no rotation, no direct fallback. For "this exit must be used".
settings.ip-pool.pinnedStrictOff: Primary + fallback: rotate on 429/drop, return when recovered
settings.ip-pool.probeConcurrencyHint: Cross-exit probe cap (1-8, default 3); one exit is always serial.
settings.ip-pool.probeFailureHint: Why the last health probe failed (the exit stays in the pool awaiting a re-probe)
settings.ip-pool.probeModelsDefault: Using the default probe model: big-pickle (first of the S3 verified list).
settings.ip-pool.probeModelsHint: Pick probe models from the list; none selected = default big-pickle. Multiple models stay serial per exit.
settings.ip-pool.readOnly: This configuration is read-only; changes cannot be saved.
settings.ip-pool.singboxPathHint: Conversion core for encrypted nodes: PATH name or absolute path. Without it they stay "pending conversion".
settings.ip-pool.statusUnavailable: Settings service unavailable; the IP pool configuration cannot be read or written.
settings.ip-pool.subscriptionHint: Airport/self-hosted Clash·V2ray subscription URLs, one per line; plaintext nodes dial directly, encrypted ones convert via sing-box.
settings.ip-pool.subscriptionRefreshMsHint: Default 1,800,000 (30 min). Subscriptions are pulled gently, never fanned out.
settings.ip-pool.subscriptionUserAgentHint: User-Agent sent when pulling subscriptions. Airports commonly allow-list it (an unlisted one returns an error page or a 502), and some pick the returned format from it: a Clash-shaped UA yields YAML, a v2ray-shaped one yields base64 links. Empty = the built-in default.
settings.ip-pool.title: IP Pool (opencode2dsh)
